data.body:
Change 3351 merged at 14:59 PST as 334295da063a5840f17d689583337dbbd1587a33. Gerrit rebased patch set 2 (98a1e8f) on submit, after LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 and 0 unresolved comments. Autodeploy started container `rebar-mcp-334295da063a-8092` at 15:03 PST.

Patch set 1 got LLM-Review -1 on the bug-fix size floor (204 non-test lines against 150). I cut the docs and comments to 149 lines and addressed the advisories:
- The step is reaped on any interruption.
- A failed or timed-out step is logged.
- New tests cover the task list, the start-up fetch flags and a malformed inherited count.

Patch set 1 also failed local make verify: the env injection made `git config --get gc.auto` look like drift to the gc-config ensure. I fixed that by exempting the `config` subcommand.

Follow-up bug filed: `successive-deceptive-xiphias`. It covers two things: no gc path now prunes unreachable objects or expires reflogs, and stale wording about auto-gc in `docs/concurrency.md` and `docs/scale-envelope.md`.

Next: re-measure production after this write is served by the new container.
